shape_hint: A split circular ring formed from round spring-steel wire, with a gap of g between the two ends that are bent slightly inward/outward; it sits in a circular groove cut into a bore and retains a part against the bore shoulder. In 2D it is a thin circle (wire cross-section dw) with a small break; free outer size Df, seated in a groove of diameter Dg.

role_map.Dh: bore (housing) diameter the ring is intended for, buyer's size
role_map.Df: free (unstressed) outside diameter of the ring
role_map.g: gap between the wire ends (reference value)

notes: Only DIN 7993 Form B (for bores/housings, sizes 7-125 mm) is tabulated. DIN 7993 Form A (for shafts) has the same wire sizes but different groove/free diameters (not tabulated: only 2 sources). DIN 7993 is withdrawn (hint: replaced by DIN 9925/9926); the dimension tables are still widely published. The family also names DIN 983/984 lugged rings, inch rings (ASME B18.27) and spiral rings (ASME B27.6): these are NOT covered. Groove-diameter tolerances (+-0.05...+-0.15) and Df tolerances (+0.3...+1.2) are not included. Only 3 sources exist, so any single typo drops a row.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched fasteners.eu /standards/din/7993-B/, boltsfastener din-7993-b.html, schrauben-lexikon DIN_7993B.asp (all 200). Parsed with tbl.py (fasteners.eu tolerance cells filtered; lexikon 3 transposed blocks). Union = 37 sizes (7..125) x 6 value cols x 3 sources. 35 record rows x 6 cols x 3 sources = 630 comparisons, 0 mismatches. Only disagreements in the 37 rows: Df(45) fe 48.0 / bolts 48.8 / lex 48.0 and Df(125) fe 129.5 / bolts 129.2 / lex 129.2, exactly the two rows the producer dropped (agreed: 2 clusters only). Sanity: Dg>Dh, Df>Dg for all rows; dw, g, Dg, Df, r non-decreasing.
problems: Exactly 3 clusters for every cell, zero slack. Independence of boltsfastener rests on the pairwise-different typos (bolts 48.8 vs fe/lex 48.0; fe 129.5 vs bolts/lex 129.2): a copy of fasteners.eu would carry 129.5, a copy of lexikon would carry 48.0. On the key-wood page boltsfastener IS a verbatim fasteners.eu copy; if the maintainer applies a blanket 'boltsfastener = fasteners.eu' rule, every row drops to 2 clusters and the record must be rejected.

boltsfastener page title says 'Round Wire Snap Rings for shaft' although it is Form B (bores) - sloppy compilation; column heads themselves (Dh, Dg, r, dw, Df, (g)) are explicit and match the record roles.

Role check: fasteners.eu header symbols d1,d4,d5,d6,e,r are not defined by words; its legend uses B=hole diameter, G=groove, D=ring diameter, g=opening range, r=radius. Lexikon rows are B,t,D,g,G,r - 't' (wire dia) is never defined and is inferred by equality with fe d4 / bolts dw. Only boltsfastener names all columns in words (wire dia, free diameter, gap, radius).
r is 'approx.' in fasteners.eu; g is a parenthesised reference value in boltsfastener ('(g)') - record already says reference; groove-diameter tolerances +-0.05/0.1/0.15 not published (fine).
Form A (shafts) correctly not published (2 sources).
